name: tiktok-social-mcp
description: TikTok (social): me, publish_image, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_tiktok_client_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY
platform_mcp_tiktok_client_key.description: Client key of your TikTok for Developers app (https://developers.tiktok.com/apps).

platform_mcp_tiktok_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_tiktok_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same app.

platform_mcp_tiktok_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_tiktok_refresh_token.description: The creator's refresh_token from the Login Kit authorization-code exchange (POST /v2/oauth/token/, valid 365 days) with scopes user.info.basic, video.publish, video.list. Access tokens (24 h) are minted from it; a rotated refresh_token replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

platform_mcp_tiktok_privacy_level.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_PRIVACY_LEVEL
platform_mcp_tiktok_privacy_level.description: privacy_level for direct photo posts: one of the creator's privacy_level_options from /v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/ (PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY). Unaudited apps can only use SELF_ONLY.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/user/info/ (user.info.basic): open_id, union_id, avatar_url, display_name of the authorised creator.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/ (video.publish) direct-posts up to 35 photos pulled from URLs (the domain or URL prefix must be verified for your app; url_ownership_unverified otherwise), `text` as the description (≤4000). `id` is the publish_id; publishing is asynchronous (poll /v2/post/publish/status/fetch/). Unaudited apps can only post SELF_ONLY; 6 requests/minute per token; the creator must have been shown TikTok's posting UX (creator_info/query) first.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: POST /v2/video/query/ (video.list) for one of the creator's own videos: like_count, comment_count, share_count, view_count, title, share_url.
